post.title: Wealthfront is a robo-advisor. 74% of revenue is cash
post.ig:
Wealthfront is a robo-advisor, but in fiscal 2026, 74% of its revenue came from cash.

Year ended Jan 31, 2026: $271.7M from cash management vs $91.9M from investment advisory, of $365.0M total.
Its S-1 put the cash management fee at about 0.60% a year as of July 2025; the advisory fee is 0.25%. On a hypothetical $10,000: about $60 vs $25 a year.
In 2022, Schwab paid $187M to settle SEC charges over cash in its no-fee robo (no admission).

Sources: Wealthfront FY2026 results (Mar 2026) and S-1 (2025); SEC (June 2022).
